Hero.bio: A QA Engineer specializing in Automation & AI Testing.

About.title: About Me
About.bio_1: I am a Quality Assurance Engineer with over 4 years of experience specializing in web, mobile, and API testing. My expertise lies in building robust automation testing frameworks using Cypress and Playwright, as well as exploring the cutting-edge of AI-driven quality management.
About.bio_2: With a strong foundation from 24+ certifications across leading platforms such as Microsoft, Google Cloud, Cisco, and Dicoding Academy, I continuously strive to implement best practices in software testing and development lifecycles.

jelajah-pintar.shortDesc: A smart navigation app using AI & Google Maps Platform to discover culinary spots and hidden gems along your travel route.
jelajah-pintar.longDesc: JelajahPintar is an innovative application that combines Artificial Intelligence (AI) with the Google Maps Platform to provide an efficient navigation experience for modern travelers. The system automatically scans the user's predetermined route, then suggests legendary culinary spots and tourist destinations (hidden gems) located right along the route without requiring the user to make U-turns (zero-detour).

lumina-aesthetic.shortDesc: An AI-powered web application for facial geometry analysis and 3D glasses simulation (AR Try-On) using Face-API and Gemini AI.
lumina-aesthetic.longDesc: LuminaAesthetic is an intelligent Optometric Design Suite that combines Computer Vision (Face-API) and Generative AI (Gemini Flash) for precise facial anatomy analysis. Key features include 68-point facial geometry detection, AR virtual glasses try-on simulation with auto-alignment, skin tone analysis, and optical medical report extraction into bilingual PDF format (ID/EN).

ml-cicd-pipeline.shortDesc: An end-to-end experimental project implementing Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) for California housing price prediction, complete with automated CI/CD pipeline.
ml-cicd-pipeline.longDesc: A comprehensive portfolio showcasing Data Science and MLOps expertise. This project is divided into two main pillars: first, designing a Python-based Machine Learning System (SML) to process the California Housing Prices dataset; second, implementing automated CI/CD Workflows using GitHub Actions that consistently test, validate, and deploy data pipelines efficiently with minimal bugs.
